definition: no_2d_candidate = the frozen 2D baseline had no legal 2D XY candidate at all (route was in router.no_candidate); no_lift_candidate = a 2D candidate exists but no legal 2.5D placement (flat or lifted) was found
source: reason field of status="failed" records in routes_25d.json; run_summary.statistics is authoritative for failed_no_candidate / failed_unplaceable

no_2d_candidate_at_all.description: routes for which the frozen 2D baseline had no legal/any 2D XY candidate at all (reason=no_2d_candidate); reported separately because they cannot be fixed by adding heights

totals.note: summed over the runs that have route records; the same route appears once per layer-count run, so cross-run sums double count routes
